entrypoints.summary: The topic material shows an HTTP POST to the stock endpoint with a form parameter named stockApi containing a URL.
The lab solution identifies the stockApi parameter as the URL-bearing input that can be changed to a localhost admin URL.

affected_components.role: The writeup describes this feature as the server-side URL fetch entrypoint.

causal_paths.kind: attacker-supplied URL to server-side localhost request

negative_controls: Direct navigation to /admin is described as inaccessible.
observability.positive_marker: The administration interface is displayed after the localhost admin URL is submitted through stockApi.

preconditions: The target is the provided training-lab instance with a stock-check feature that fetches data from an internal system.
The attacker can submit or intercept a stock-check request containing stockApi.

trigger_steps.summary: Replace stockApi with the localhost admin URL to obtain the administration interface through the server-side fetch.
Submit the discovered localhost administrative deletion URL through stockApi for the named lab user.

capabilities.concept: Server-side request to server-local administrative endpoint

mitigations.concept: Authorized destination restriction for stock-check requests

relation_candidates.dst: Server-side request to server-local administrative endpoint
relation_candidates.rationale: The lab procedure changes stockApi to localhost administrative URLs, which the stock-check feature fetches.
The described follow-on localhost URL is the admin deletion endpoint for user carlos and is submitted through stockApi.
relation_candidates.src: Server-side request to server-local administrative endpoint

relation_candidates.dst: Authorized destination restriction for stock-check requests
relation_candidates.rationale: Restricting the stock-check fetch to its authorized stock-service destinations would prevent selection of the localhost admin destination; no source patch verifies a specific implementation.
relation_candidates.src: Server-side request to server-local administrative endpoint

impact.affected_asset: Local administrative interface and user account data.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the application to request localhost administrative URLs, including the deletion endpoint for carlos.
impact.security_effect: Unauthorized access to a server-local administration interface and deletion of the named user in the lab.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker controls the URL submitted in the stockApi parameter of the stock-check request.
The stock-check feature accepts a destination that resolves to the server-local admin interface rather than restricting the server-side fetch to its intended internal stock system.
The server-side stock-check fetch is directed to http://localhost/admin and subsequently to the localhost admin deletion URL for user carlos.
The server-side request can expose the administration interface and invoke its user-deletion action for the specified account.

failure.operation: Server-side HTTP fetch using attacker-selected stockApi destination

primary_invariant.statement: A user-supplied stockApi value must not cause the application to issue requests to the server-local administrative interface or its privileged actions.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The supplied lab procedure changes stockApi to localhost admin URLs and states that this displays the administration interface and delivers the deletion request.

quality.review_notes: This is a PortSwigger training-lab writeup, not source code, a patch, or an observed execution transcript. The page specifies an HTTP oracle and solution procedure, but the bundle contains no run result for a particular lab instance. No remediation implementation or patch is supplied; the mitigation class is an inferred invariant-restoration candidate.

remediation.invariant_restored: The stock-check URL cannot select localhost administrative routes or other destinations outside the authorized stock-service destination set.
mitigation_classes: Restrict server-side stock-check request destinations to authorized stock-service endpoints

target.project_or_package: PortSwigger Web Security Academy lab instance

oracle.channel: HTTP stock-check request and response content
oracle.expected_negative: A direct browse to /admin is described as inaccessible before routing the request through the stock-check feature.
oracle.expected_positive: Submitting the localhost admin URL through stockApi displays the administration interface; submitting the localhost deletion URL targets deletion of user carlos.
